$comment: Sources for the braille portraits in art/. origin: "commons" is public domain or CC0 and lives in assets/sources/, fetched by scripts/fetch-sources.sh; "local" cannot be re-fetched from anywhere and lives committed in assets/local/. transcoder: "ascii" hands the crop to `omarchy transcode ascii` at threshold percent, right for a drawing; "halftone" blurs, levels and dithers it through tone, right for a photograph. See the Portraits section of README.md, and re-run scripts/transcode.ts to rebuild art/.
